name: Hon. Precision, Inc.
summary: Hon. Precision, Inc., a company based in Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of industrial machinery, associated components, and automated control systems. The firm also provides comprehensive machinery installation services within Taiwan. Their diverse product portfolio features advanced automated test sorting machines, which incorporate capabilities such as visual AOI/AI computing processing, versatile temperature control (for normal, high, and low ranges), down force application, barcode integration, and robust network, communication, and database functionalities. Furthermore, Hon. Precision supplies a variety of test handler solutions, including those for final testing, system-level testing, flash memory testing, dynamic random access memory (DRAM) testing, automatic optical inspection (AOI), and micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) testing. The company also offers specialized thermal management solutions, equipment for laboratory development, and environmental burn-in ovens. Established in 1999, the company's headquarters are located in Taichung, Taiwan.
